independent_reproduction.tests: 7 passed in 0.099 seconds using a fresh temporary project-shaped directory; this exercised AST/source drift checks and tiny invented Pickler fixtures only.

supported_design_claims: AST pins the original runner's full Jacobian-inclusive model.logp, strict identity graph replacement, rewrite_pregrad before native gradient(rewritten, ordered), then exactly one pickle.dump of the seven roots [original_cost, replaced_cost, rewritten_cost, gradient, ordered_value_vars, E, segments] with protocol 5 and no buffer callback. Single-dump ordering preserves shared memo identity in principle.

The original runner's source pins, factor inventory, shape witness, first-parent identity/mass/target checks, explicit exposure checks and 662-coordinate segment ledger remain pinned inputs. Existing first-parent mass remains outside conditional logp; this is not an all-parent graph.

Tiny sink tests support pre-write budget behavior, accepted-prefix count/hash, one-memo byte oracle and observed toy-child output. They correctly do not establish actual graph size, persistence, restore, numerical parity or normalization.

The 512 MiB logical cap, 120-second wall, 90/95 CPU, 2 GiB RSS watcher, 6 GiB address-space cap, one thread/nice15 and small report/cache budget are explicit prospective bounds, not executed or enforced by this source-analysis packet.

pre_execution_gaps.finding: This is a design-only record: source-bound execution record, fresh resource observation, selected controller source and independent design review remain null. No executable actual-TX discard-sink runner or external success receipt exists here. Do not treat it as run authorization or measurement evidence.

The design cites a cooperating exclusive-writer protocol but does not implement or pin it. Prior V3 review found verification TOCTOU under concurrent mutation and an external success.json post-rename fsync failure whose hash can be recomputed. Any future runner must either enforce exclusive immutable output and caller-retained receipt provenance or use a reviewed stable-snapshot protocol; do not adopt local file hashes alone as completion proof.

Tiny durable progress invokes two fsyncs per Pickler write; observed toy streams have only one or three writes. Actual graph callback count and its effect on the 120-second cap are unknown. Every per-write durable update must be included in the budget, or any throttling must specify that persisted prefix is a lower bound and final success persists the exact final digest/count.

Package METADATA versions are not executable runtime-closure attestation. The README correctly requires a future runner to verify actual imported module paths/bytes, interpreter/executable and environment before graph construction.

A 512 MiB capped stream can establish only a lower bound if exceeded. Pickler transient allocations remain bounded only by RSS/address-space limits; no actual graph memory or serialization performance is predicted by toy measurements.

pickle_boundary: No payload is stored or loaded. Hashes and a completed count do not make pickle safe to deserialize. Restoration requires an independent authenticated provenance protocol and separate restore/identity test; it is not part of this design.
verdict: source analysis and tiny test design are sound within stated limits; not ready as an executed measurement and no actual graph run performed
recommendation: Before any future actual-TX size run, freeze a concrete source-bound runner/controller, exact source/runtime/root/parent/shape pins, fresh resource observation, exclusive-output/completion protocol addressing the prior V3 verification caveats, and independent review. Then count one stream only; cap/failure remains an explicit lower bound and must not be followed by loading the old partial pickle.
